All enrichment methods authenticate via an `access_token` cookie and return enrichment JSON.

## Command functions
- **`get_url_command`** — Formats URL entity data (malicious score, IPs, hostname, domain), detected activities, and related entities into markdown tables.
- **`get_ipv4_command`** — Formats IPv4 data including geo (country/city), ASN details, suspicious URLs/domains, activities, and related entities.
